unique_voters.title: Unique voters
unique_voters.meaning: The full deduplicated NDBA voter universe after merging Memberlist and Sheet1. This is the campaign’s addressable base.
unique_voters.campaign: Use as the master list for turnout ops, commitment tracking, and booth pairing — every other lever is a slice of this set.

juniors_2018plus.title: Juniors 2018+
juniors_2018plus.meaning: Advocates enrolled in 2018 or later — the largest single age/enrolment bloc and the most open to welfare messaging.
juniors_2018plus.campaign: Primary growth engine: mentorship desk, WhatsApp briefs, batchmate calls, and P1 PHC-junior corridor visits.

ncr_belt.title: NCR belt geo
ncr_belt.meaning: Voters whose residential address tags to the wider NCR commute belt (Ghaziabad, Noida, Faridabad, Gurgaon, and related clusters).
ncr_belt.campaign: Outstation counsel facilitation and evening phone banks — frame Sanjeev as the voice of commuting PHC lawyers.

home_belt.title: GZB / Murad / Indirapuram home belt
home_belt.meaning: Home-turf cluster: Ghaziabad, Muradnagar, and Indirapuram addresses — densest personal network for Sanjeev.
home_belt.campaign: Week-2 sweep priority (P0). Tea meets, colony captains, and first-touch commitments before expanding NCR-wide.

phc_chamber.title: PHC chamber on file
phc_chamber.meaning: Members with a Patiala House chamber number on record — high-contact corridor targets.
phc_chamber.campaign: Chamber captains by number ranges; 90-second door visits with leave-behind card and one introduction ask.

jat_high.title: Jat surname HIGH
jat_high.meaning: Possible affinity only — distinctive Jat/Chaudhary-associated gotra or surname matches. Not verified caste.
jat_high.campaign: Soft lever: private hospitality and introductions, never a public caste campaign. Stack with geo/junior/chamber.

jat_medium.title: Jat surname MED
jat_medium.meaning: Medium-confidence surname matches shared with other communities — treat as soft possible affinity only.
jat_medium.campaign: Lower priority than HIGH; use only as a secondary warm introduction path alongside stronger levers.

practice.title: Practice keywords
practice.meaning: Rows with an explicit crime/family practice signal in source data — almost empty because practice is not coded in the rolls.
practice.campaign: Do not rely on this tag. Build practice lists manually via peer referral among criminal & family board advocates.

junior_2022plus.title: Junior 2022+
junior_2022plus.meaning: Newest cohort (enrolled 2022 or later) — freshest to bar politics and most responsive to junior-welfare pledges.
junior_2022plus.campaign: Batchmate WhatsApp trees, mentorship desk invites, and polling-day pairing with seniors.

junior_2018_2021.title: Junior 2018–21
junior_2018_2021.meaning: Second junior band — still early-career but with a few years of PHC experience.
junior_2018_2021.campaign: Peer endorsements and chamber introductions; many already sit near P1 PHC-junior priority.

mid_2012_2017.title: Mid 2012–17
mid_2012_2017.meaning: Mid-career enrolment band — includes Sanjeev’s own 2012 cohort peers.
mid_2012_2017.campaign: Batchmate goodwill and practice-peer outreach; useful bridge between juniors and seniors.

mid_2005_2011.title: Mid 2005–11
mid_2005_2011.meaning: Established mid-senior band — influence on chambers and listing culture.
mid_2005_2011.campaign: Courtesy visits and endorsement asks; keep messaging professional and issue-based.

senior_pre2005.title: Senior pre-2005
senior_pre2005.meaning: Long-enrolled seniors — high goodwill value, lower volume responsiveness.
senior_pre2005.campaign: Quiet Week-1 courtesy calls (20–30); never pressure. Ask for one junior introduction where appropriate.

unknown.title: Unknown enrolment year
unknown.meaning: Rows where enrolment year could not be parsed from the roll.
unknown.campaign: Manual clean-up: confirm year before assigning cohort captains.
